# Takumi Halal Mart

Takumi Halal Mart (https://www.takumihalalmart.store) is Japan's premier halal grocery store, located in Togane-shi, Chiba, Japan. We sell 100% halal certified meat and poultry, fresh Sri Lankan and South Asian produce, authentic spices and herbs, beverages, rice, grains, and household essentials.

## Who We Are
Founded by the team behind Kabir Motors Co. (est. 2016) and ZEE YASAI imports (est. 2024), Takumi Halal Mart opened its physical store in Chiba in March 2026. We serve the Muslim, South Asian, and expat communities across Japan.

## What We Sell
- Halal meat and poultry (100% certified)
- Fresh Sri Lankan and South Asian vegetables and fruits
- Authentic spices and herbs
- Beverages (Japanese and South Asian)
- Rice, grains, and pulses
- Household essentials

## Retail & Wholesale
We offer both retail pricing for individual shoppers and wholesale pricing for restaurants, caterers, and retailers. Wholesale registration: https://www.takumihalalmart.store/wholesale
